scripts.build: npm run build:zh && npm run build:en
scripts.build:zh: slidev build slides-zh.md --base /talk/zh/ --out dist/zh && rm -rf ../talk/zh && mkdir -p ../talk && cp -r dist/zh ../talk/zh
scripts.build:en: slidev build slides-en.md --base /talk/en/ --out dist/en && rm -rf ../talk/en && mkdir -p ../talk && cp -r dist/en ../talk/en
scripts.pdf: slidev export slides-zh.md --output fusion-talk-zh.pdf && slidev export slides-en.md --output fusion-talk-en.pdf
